title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):
summary: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Launched on 28 August 2014 by the Ministry of Finance, aims to provide financial inclusion to
deprived sections of society.
Objectives:
Financial Inclusion – One bank account per household.
Basic Banking Services – Accessible to the underprivileged.
Key Features:
Zero Balance Accounts – No minimum balance required.
Accident Insurance – ₹2 lakh coverage.
Overdraft Facility – ₹10,000 for eligible users.
Rupay Debit Card – Provided to account holders.
Direct Benefit Transfers – For government benefits.
Mobile Banking – Accessible through mobile phones.
Achievements:
53 crore accounts opened (29 crore by women).
₹1.75 lakh crore in deposits.
Challenges:
Account Dormancy – Many accounts remain inactive.
Infrastructure Gaps – Limited banking access in some rural areas.
PMJDY empowers low-income families with access to financial services and government benefits.
